title: An open immersion into a smooth morphism has smooth composite
statement: Let $i:Z\to Y$ be an open immersion of schemes [def-weil-open-immersion], and let $f:Y\to S$ be a smooth morphism of schemes [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Then the composite $f\circ i:Z\to S$ is smooth over $S$.

source.place: Morphisms, Lemmas 01VC (an open immersion is smooth) and 01VA (composition of smooth morphisms is smooth)
